plugins.name: gauge
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: turn, output speed, turn and session cost, prompt cache countdown and context fill.

plugins.name: deck
plugins.description: A row per subagent, workflow agent, Kiro run (kiro-cli chat) and background task: Pixel Clawd or Kiro's ghost in a costume (random by default), a submarine for background tasks, with running, finished and failed counts, time and a memory warning from 70% (/deck details adds cost, requests, tokens processed, memory and Kiro's credits), and a dithered progress band above the prompt while they run.

plugins.name: bulkhead
plugins.description: Guard for dangerous shell commands: blocks the catastrophic and stops the risky for a person to run or confirm.

plugins.name: livery
plugins.description: Conversation theme for the desktop app: a tinted reply with an accent strip, a blue prompt, code cards and tool rows colored by kind.

plugins.name: logbook
plugins.description: Where Claude got its context, turn by turn: skills, MCP calls, files, web, subagents and what each used, shell programs and instruction files, with estimated tokens. A dim line under each reply and a timeline pane; spends no model tokens.
